title: Telemetry session entry
description: One line of a generated project's docs/telemetry/sessions.jsonl - one JSON object per session, appended (never rewritten) at session end.

session_id.description: Stable identifier for the session, e.g. "2026-07-24-phase3-design" (date + short slug). Not reused across sessions.

duration_minutes.description: Wall-clock session length in minutes, derived from started_at/ended_at.

phase.description: Roadmap phase active during this session, e.g. "Phase 3 - Designing". Matches the phase names in docs/strategy/roadmap.md.

roadmap_path.description: Optional - the project's current roadmap path, if the session touched or depended on it.

activity.description: One-sentence summary of what the session actually did.

source.description: "rtk" if a reliable per-session figure was available from rtk/cc-economics at write time; "estimate" otherwise (see this template's README for why "rtk" is not yet the default).

value.description: Token count (input+output combined) for the session, from whichever source is named above.

artifacts_created.description: Repo-relative paths of new files this session. Derive from `git status`/`git diff --name-status` at session end, not by hand.

artifacts_updated.description: Repo-relative paths of modified files this session. Derive from `git status`/`git diff --name-status` at session end, not by hand.

decisions.description: Optional - short plain-language record of decisions made this session that a git log alone would not make obvious.

blockers.description: Optional - what's currently blocking progress, if anything.

next_action.description: The single next step, matching what /docs/status.md already records.
